evidence: Judge agent+model are set once for all five dimensions in task.toml [verifier.env] (REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code, REWARDKIT_MODEL=z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, lines 30-35), byte-identical to the frozen template; test.sh:63-64 refuses to run if either is unset and every judge.toml only carries the claude-code fallback. tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template and pins the judge CLIs and browser: @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (Chromium installed via that package's bundled playwright cli and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which every judge.toml passes via --executable-path), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the template (diff -r shows only a __pycache__ dir in the frozen cache, absent from projects/kittle-matter-chat/tests/tools, so a QC-side compile artifact, not a shipped file; row 50 owns it). Graded time rules run on a public fixed clock: integration.md:7 states 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z; seed clock (both copies identical) matches; golden server.js derives all message/edit/transcript times and timer expiry from CLOCK_MS (lines 33,143,417,438,516) with no Date.now in grading paths; criteria quote the fixed clock explicitly (functional judge.toml:125,228,255; app_context.md:29) so the judge never relies on the run date. Weak-app probe: an app using the real run date (Oct 2026) would erase every seeded timed message, failing the one-second-younger positive control at functional:125 and the 30-day M-13 controls at :136 - caught. Conforming alternative (any time format, fixed clock read from seed or hard-coded) passes since criteria accept any clear format. Not required per the public row: temperature/prompt-version markers; open public network (network_mode=public) is not a defect. Residual non-blocking observation: base images (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and apt fonts are tag-pinned not digest-pinned, but they are template-controlled and outside the row's enumerated pins. The internal annotation (temperature 0, versioned prompt, no unpinned network) is superseded by the public workbook row and skill note. This is a static/source verdict; raw-evidence-index confirms no full configured judge run exists for these bytes, which affects other runtime rows, not pinning.
